environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer with public-facing target group. ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the service on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on the ALB and 8080 from the ALB security group on the instance. No request filtering or signing validation is configured.

config.network: ALB public-facing, target group port 8080, no WAF attached
config.access: Direct HTTP access to /api/v1/render endpoint, no authentication
